note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_BacklogAging (sql/22_dimension_backlog_aging.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Counted as of today (no report period); counts overdue DUE DATES (schedules), not obligations - one obligation can have several overdue due dates. Financial year runs 1 April - 31 March. Live figure: a check run later can differ slightly.
setup: DECLARE @currentFyStart DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(CASE WHEN MONTH(@AsOf) >= 4 THEN YEAR(@AsOf) ELSE YEAR(@AsOf) - 1 END, 4, 1);
-- Step 1. Overdue due dates right now (past due and not closed, or never touched - ComplianceScheduleOn,
--         ComplianceTransaction) at the locations AND categories this user may see, each put in one bucket by its
--         due date (ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn): this financial year, last financial year, or older.
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;
CASE WHEN o.ScheduleOn >= @currentFyStart THEN 'current_fy' WHEN o.ScheduleOn >= @previousFyStart THEN 'previous_fy' ELSE 'older' END AS Bucket
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BranchID, CategoryId FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopePairs(@UserID, @CustomerID)) sp
ON sp.BranchID = o.CustomerBranchID AND sp.CategoryId = o.CategoryId

checks.name: All overdue due dates
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceScheduleOnID) AS Value FROM #ovd;

checks.name: Sum of the three age buckets
checks.tables: Every overdue due date sits in exactly one bucket, so this equals K1.
query: SELECT SUM(n) AS Value FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceScheduleOnID) AS n FROM #ovd GROUP BY Bucket) x;

checks.name: Overdue due dates in an age bucket
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ComplianceScheduleOnID) AS Value FROM #ovd WHERE Bucket = '{RowKey}';

checks.name: An age bucket's share of all overdue due dates (%)
checks.tables: W1 / K1 x 100. Blank when nothing is overdue.
query: SELECT CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Bucket = '{RowKey}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value FROM #ovd;
